# Places To Visit in Dominican Republic

> Dominican Republic Places To Visit (dominicanrepublicplacestovisit.com) is an independent, bilingual (English/Spanish) travel guide to the Dominican Republic: Punta Cana, Santo Domingo, Cabarete, Samaná, Jarabacoa, beaches and more.

## Pages
- [Home](https://dominicanrepublicplacestovisit.com/): destinations, beaches, FAQ and a contact form for travelers and businesses

## Editorial notes
This is not an official government tourism website. Verify prices, hours, entry requirements and ocean conditions with current official sources.

## Primary authoritative source
https://www.godominicanrepublic.com/
